bullets.text: Action Against Deepfakes - UK PM Keir Starmer condemns **X** for Grok AI's sexualized deepfakes and vows regulatory action.
Apple Store Closure - **Apple**'s flagship Regent Street store in London to close for refurbishments next week.
ChatGPT Health Launch - **OpenAI** introduces 'ChatGPT Health' to integrate health data from **Apple Health** and others.
Towerborne's Paid Shift - **Xbox**'s Towerborne transitions from free-to-play to a paid model for a complete gaming experience.
Pioneer's CarPlay Innovation - **Pioneer** unveils aftermarket receiver with Dolby Atmos for enhanced in-car audio experience.
CES 2026 Highlights - Major tech reveals at **CES 2026**, featuring **Nvidia**'s AI advancements and **AMD**'s new processors.
Cyera's Valuation Surge - Data security startup **Cyera** reaches a $9 billion valuation after a $400 million funding round.
NSO's Transparency Report - **NSO Group** faces criticism over its transparency claims amid efforts to enter the US market.
Elon Musk's Legal Battle - **Elon Musk**'s lawsuit against **OpenAI** will proceed to trial in March over contractual disputes.
Disney+ Short-Form Videos - **Disney** plans to launch short-form video content on **Disney+** to enhance user engagement.
